intent_dna: Preserve relay availability without weakening owner-governed self-improvement controls.
capability_gap: One malformed or tampered mailbox packet can stop processing of later valid requests.
proposed_change: Quarantine invalid packets as BLOCKED with content-addressed evidence and continue processing later valid requests; add owner approval receipt ingestion and a confined worktree test runner.
expected_benefit: A single invalid packet no longer blocks valid self-improvement delivery while preserving fail-closed evidence.
risks: An invalid packet could be quarantined because of an implementation defect.
A runner could exceed approved scope if path or command validation fails.
validation_plan: Prove malformed and tampered packets are quarantined.
Prove a later valid request is still delivered.
Prove approval scope and path tampering are rejected.
Run full regression and Ruff checks.
